content: SQLAlchemy stable is 2.0.52 (2.1 in RC as of 2026-09). Guidance: commit fully to sync OR async; mixing hurts. Async only pays off for high-concurrency servers; async routes with sync DB calls are worse than pure sync. For a CLI-first deterministic orchestrator that runs one run at a time per process, sync engine + psycopg3 is recommended.
